required_later_target.approved_image_reference: see image_requirements; null approval refuses creation
required_later_target.capability_rule: startup only; reviewed shim proves postgres/psql have zero effective capabilities after dropping root
required_later_target.security_profiles: reviewed default seccomp/AppArmor; no unconfined or additional profile/privilege override
required_later_target.namespace_rule: pin reviewed engine-version representations; reject host modes and container:<id> sharing
required_later_target.mount_rule: sole PGDATA tmpfs with every specified option and 512 MiB runtime capacity; reject image-declared anonymous volumes, reparse/symlink data paths and external tablespace/WAL/log storage
required_later_target.ownership: cryptographically fresh token; record same-engine create acknowledgement, full ID, name, labels, approved image before start; no existing-target input
required_later_target.lost_create_response: create before start; recover full ID only from fresh exclusive cidfile plus matching same-engine create event and exact ownership/image inspection; missing or contradictory provenance means INCOMPLETE, no guessed target
required_later_target.missing_unknown_fields: REFUSE; independently approve version-specific null/empty/default and legacy/mirrored tmpfs representations before use

bootstrap_requirements.startup_scope: chown/chmod only inspected tmpfs mount itself; no recursive host operations; drop root/capabilities before initdb/server/psql
bootstrap_requirements.availability: UNVERIFIED_NOT_RUN: exact version/control/SQL/shared-library availability needs later local verification
bootstrap_requirements.psql: docker exec --user postgres to validated full ID only; -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -h /var/lib/postgresql/data -U postgres -d postgres; no TCP/DSN/host-client fallback
bootstrap_requirements.effective_checks: after metadata acceptance, reviewed socket-only probe verifies data_directory/socket/listener/HBA, runtime tmpfs options/capacity, OS uid/capabilities and versions; failed probe fails and destroys lane

required_later_checks: full ID ownership before every operation
immutable digest/content image ID and local availability
authorization_rule: Specification only. Future independently reviewed dedicated adapter/startup supervisor and explicit execution authorization required; no execution flag exists. Existing runners and their purpose allowlist remain unchanged.

before_create: successful local image inspect without pull
approved repository@sha256 digest resolves to approved sha256 content image ID
linux/amd64 and reviewed entrypoint/tools/extension libraries match
image_requirements.create_reference: approved repository@sha256 digest only, --pull=never; absence/mismatch refuses creation without build/download/substitution
image_requirements.inspect_identity: container Image equals approved content image ID; Config.Image equals approved digest reference

docker_control.context_selection: PROHIBITED: no --context or mutable context store used for operations
docker_control.configuration: fresh private local config directory; approved bytes or absence of unexpected files checked before each invocation; no credentials, credential helpers or CLI plugins
docker_control.environment: explicit allowlist of reviewed Windows system essentials only; reject Docker overrides and exclude inherited DOCKER*, PG*, DATABASE_URL, SUPABASE*, HOME/user configuration and provider credentials
docker_control.commands: argument vector, pinned executable, reviewed subcommands/flags only; no shell or PATH lookup
docker_control.recheck: same endpoint and approved engine ID, healthy daemon and exact resource ownership before each lifecycle/readiness/SQL/copy/signal operation
docker_control.trust_limit: named-pipe access grants daemon-wide authority; tokens/labels do not protect against a hostile daemon administrator or mutable trusted host

process_and_shutdown.tracking: track each in-container exec/client process group, PID and start identity; concurrency clients individually; signal only verified identities on owned full ID, never guessed PIDs or host processes
process_and_shutdown.deadline: external monotonic deadline plus reviewed in-container supervisor; killing host Docker CLI does not establish psql/backend termination
process_and_shutdown.timeout_interruption: stop further replay/ledger/copy; fail lane; TERM tracked client groups then bounded KILL if needed; collect termination evidence and shut down whole owned cluster
process_and_shutdown.backend_rule: client exit is insufficient; require cluster/container shutdown/removal evidence proving no surviving PostgreSQL runtime
process_and_shutdown.shutdown: ownership-check exact full ID then Docker stop --timeout 10; if still running ownership-recheck before kill; if stopped but not auto-removed ownership-recheck before exact-ID rm; each call and overall cleanup bounded
process_and_shutdown.unverified_termination: INCOMPLETE if ownership, daemon identity/access, client/backend termination or removal cannot be verified

cleanup_evidence.always: finally on success/failure/bootstrap/replay/ledger/copy/timeout/interruption; destructive operations only when recorded creation ownership and daemon identity remain provable
cleanup_evidence.ownership_only: same engine/full ID/token/name/purpose/image; failed bootstrap/storage validation still permits cleanup of proven-created resource; no generic allowlist expansion
independent_required: healthy same-engine inspect specifically reports full ID absent, not generic failure
separate successful all-container query filtered by full ID confirms absence
correlated daemon die/destroy events or independently reviewed equivalent runtime-removal evidence (including never-started containers)
cleanup_evidence.resources: before-inspect proves sole bounded tmpfs, no persistent volumes/bridges; independent destroy/runtime-removal evidence must establish task and container-managed mount/scratch release; stop return value or time elapsed alone is insufficient
cleanup_evidence.evidence_limit: daemon lifecycle evidence does not attest physical memory erasure or Docker Desktop VM swap; unavailable resource-release evidence means INCOMPLETE
cleanup_evidence.already_removed: require healthy-daemon independent absence and correlated removal evidence, even if --rm raced inspection

run_status.success: COMPLETE only after all approved assertions and independent cleanup evidence pass
run_status.unverified_ownership_daemon_termination_: INCOMPLETE; retain sanitized evidence for operator resolution
run_status.acceptance_completion: INCOMPLETE/nonzero status for any failed assertion, blocked/skipped subcase, known source exposure or missing evidence. FAILED_CLEANED is a separate resource outcome, never successful acceptance.
run_status.matrix: M01-M21 NOT RUN; offline unit/hash results do not satisfy runtime cases.

expected_error_handling.continuing_probe: Anonymous INVOKER nested EXCEPTION subtransaction around one exact statement at actual test role. GET STACKED DIAGNOSTICS; accept exact SQLSTATE AND source diagnostic only; rethrow all unexpected errors. Assertions outside catch. Never use SECURITY DEFINER test helper.
expected_error_handling.isolation: Outer savepoint before role/claims/setup; inspect post-operation state after nested recovery, then rollback/release outer savepoint and compare restored state. One still-open S connection through all probes/postflight/final ROLLBACK.
expected_error_handling.whole_file_refusal: Nonzero psql exit plus exact verbose SQLSTATE/statement/origin; verified backend exit/rollback then independent new-connection catalog/row comparison. No continuation in aborted transaction.
expected_error_handling.concurrent_steps: One explicit transaction per participant/step. Expected statement error recovered in nested subtransaction then whole participant ROLLBACK. Record server lock order and commit boundaries. Timeout/deadlock never a semantic rejection.
expected_error_handling.unexpected_error: ON_ERROR_STOP stays 1; stop statements/ledger; close and verify rollback/backend termination; unconditional ownership-only cleanup; overall acceptance INCOMPLETE/nonzero status.
expected_error_handling.no_runtime_claim: Savepoint/subtransaction/SQLSTATE/lock/cleanup semantics remain source-derived expectations, NOT runtime verified.

runtime_prerequisite_identities.version_selection: Inherited bootstrap versions are requirements only, not approved/available selections. All additional versions remain unresolved; no silent substitution.
runtime_prerequisite_identities.image_verification: Before create, independently approved repository digest/content ID and full in-image tool/file provenance must match local pinned-CLI inspect on approved engine with pull=never. No pull/build/download/substitution.
runtime_prerequisite_identities.cli_verification: Checked non-reparse absolute executable raw hash/length before every invocation; version/build bound to independently approved executable/dependency bytes; no PATH/shell/plugin lookup.
runtime_prerequisite_identities.engine_verification: Exact named pipe/private config; approved engine ID/OS/Engine/API/Desktop version identity and healthy status before every operation; mutable context is never used.
runtime_prerequisite_identities.effective_verification: Only under separate future authorization: socket-only PostgreSQL version/settings, exact extension schema/version and process/tmpfs/capability checks after metadata approval; missing evidence refuses or INCOMPLETE.

decision_register.legacy_rule: Preserve signatures/behavior/ACLs unless a separately supported authorized project-owner decision approves an exact change.
